title: Returning customers
summary: How many different cards paid each week, and how many came back. No card numbers or names are kept.

blocks.text: Each week: how many different cards paid, and how many of them came back (had paid before, or paid on two different days).

items: Only a scrambled code of each card is kept, for at most 400 days. Never a card number or a name.
Cash customers aren't counted, and one person with two cards counts twice.
The first weeks look lower, because there is less history to match against.

blocks.text: Read it as a trend, not an exact head count.
